declarations.description:
Covers a region while it loads: a card refreshing its numbers, a table fetching its next page, a form saving. The
content stays where it is, dimmed under a scrim with a spinner in the middle, and cannot be clicked, typed into or
tabbed to until loading ends; the layout does not jump, as it would if the content were swapped for a placeholder.
Use `c2-skeleton` instead when there is nothing to show yet.

While `loading`, the content is `inert` and marked busy (`aria-busy`), and a polite live region beside it announces
the `label`, the text of the `label` slot, or the translatable "Loading". Focus inside the content when loading
starts is lost with it, as the browser drops focus from inert content; move it somewhere useful first if the user
was typing.

The overlay fades in after `--c2-loading-overlay--delay`, and the announcement waits as long, so a load that
finishes quickly is neither seen nor heard; the content is blocked from the start either way.
declarations.name: LoadingOverlay

cssProperties.description: Colour of the scrim; follows the surface in dark mode.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay__scrim--background-color

cssProperties.description: How much of the content the scrim hides.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay__scrim--opacity

cssProperties.description: Blur of the content under the scrim; `0px` for none.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay__scrim--blur

cssProperties.description: Rounds the scrim to match the region; it follows the host's own radius by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Stacking of the overlay above the content.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay--z-index

cssProperties.description: Wait before the overlay shows and is announced, e.g. `300ms` so quick loads go unnoticed.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay--delay

cssProperties.description: Space between the spinner and the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-loading-overlay__indicator--gap

cssParts.description: Container of the spinner (or the `indicator` slot) and the label.
cssParts.name: indicator

cssParts.description: Container of the `label` slot; hidden while it is empty.
cssParts.name: label

slots.description: Text under the spinner, e.g. "Saving changes…". Also what is announced.
slots.name: label

members.name: loading
members.description: Covers the content and blocks it.

members.name: label
members.description: What is announced when loading starts. Defaults to the `label` slot's text, then the translatable "Loading".

members.name: announcing
members.description: Whether the live region holds the announcement; set after the delay, never in the render that shows the scrim.

members.name: serverRendered
members.description: A declarative shadow root is already there in the constructor: the element was rendered on the server.

members.name: scheduleAnnouncement
members.description: Fills the live region once the scrim's delay has passed (and at least a frame after the region exists).
